questions.question: Which nutrient is mainly responsible for providing energy to our body?
questions.explanation: Carbohydrates are an important source of energy for the body.

questions.question: Which nutrient is needed for growth and repair of body tissues?
questions.explanation: Proteins help in growth and repair of body tissues.

questions.question: Which vitamin helps maintain good eyesight?
questions.explanation: Vitamin A is important for maintaining healthy eyesight.

questions.question: Which of the following is a source of dietary fat?
questions.explanation: Butter contains a significant amount of fat.

questions.question: Which test is commonly used to detect starch in food?
questions.explanation: Iodine turns blue-black in the presence of starch.
